= I believe so; the playing staff here fit my philosophy and that's a big part of why I came here | I really believe in my system, but it requires a certain type of player, which is the kind of player I want to bring in to the side | I've always enjoyed that style of football but, at the end of the day, my job is to get the best out of the players | Every group of players brings a different set of strengths and weaknesses for a manager, so I'm looking forward to finding the system that suits them best | To be honest, I think this has all been overstated in the media. The results come first and I plan to set the team up to get them

= I can honestly say there were no problems at any stage. This is meant to be | I knew I had to jump at the chance if it came my way and I'm very lucky it did | Not particularly, although I'm not naive enough to think there won't be rough times to go along with the smooth, as there are in any job | I know I've had a lot of faith put in me and I have to make sure I repay that faith each and every day | I'd say they were more questions than reservations, but I know the challenges of the job, and I'm looking forward to tackling them
